verdict.rationale: Qapita documents managing option plans and grants, but nothing in the pack describes a programmatic surface (API, SDK, or MCP) an agent could use to draft securities, nor a board-approval queue for drafts. OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The axis applies to an equity-management platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
